senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) fold, crease, wrinkle, crumple.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 7:1">Neg. VII, 1</cite> <he>בק׳ ונגלה</he> when the white spot was covered up by a wrinkle, and then became visible; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 2:13">Tosef. ib. II, 13</cite> <he>והק׳ שנפשט</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:8">Nidd. V, 8</cite> <he>משיעלה הק׳ וכ׳</he> when wrinkles are formed under the breast; expl.

<cite ref="Niddah 47a:40">ib. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שתחזיר ידיה … הק׳ וכ׳</he> when she turns her arm backwards, and it has the appearance as if there were wrinkles; a. e.—Pl. <he>קְמָטִים</he>, <cite ref="S00291"><he>קְמָטִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 6:8">Neg. VI, 8</cite> <he>הק׳ והק׳ שבצואר וכ׳</he> the folds on the body (armpit &c., v. <cite ref="S00385"><he>קוּמָּט</he></cite>), and the folds on the neck &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:5">Mikv. VIII, 5</cite> <he>בית הק׳</he> parts of the body which have folds, contrad. to <he>בית הסתרים</he>, v. <cite ref="O01715"><he>סֵתֶר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 66b:7">Nidd. 66ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 120a">B. Bath. 120ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00153"><he>עָדַן</he></cite>; a. e.
